title: Hubspot academy hero animated right loss

change.control: Existing HubSpot Academy homepage hero, variant A.
change.variant: Add color and movement, with animated images on the right side of the hero.

quote: As a result, HubSpot found that variant B outperformed the control by 6%. In contrast, variant C underperformed the control by 1%.
notes: One arm-versus-control comparison from a three-arm test. 55,000+ page views and 0.9% video watching describe prior diagnostic data, not the experiment sample. Current article was originally published in October 2014 and later updated; original exact publication day unknown.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
